M1_understand.notes: Skill is comprehensive sdk-guide covering GraphQL, WS auction, EIP-712 signing, forecasting. Clear auth method (wallet signing, no API keys).

M2_authenticate.notes: GraphQL API works without auth. SDK installed (v0.2.0). Wallet loaded from Keychain. submitForecast() works end-to-end.

M3_list_markets.notes: 10+ active markets returned via questions query. Conditions include id, question, endTime, resolver, openInterest, similarMarkets.

M4_market_detail.notes: Full condition detail + Polymarket prices retrieved. Iran regime market: YES 2.55%, NO 97.45%.

M5_buy_order.notes: Forecast submitted on-chain (EAS attestation on Arbitrum, tx confirmed). Auction flow failed: SDK v0.2 uses SIWE protocol but server expects v0.4 EIP-712 AuctionIntent. Signature verification failed. Additionally, no WUSDe on Ethereal for collateral.

M6_verify_position.notes: No position tokens — forecasts are EAS attestations, not position tokens. Would need successful auction+mint for positions.

M7_sell_position.notes: No position to sell. Full trade cycle requires WUSDe on Ethereal + working auction flow.

M8_check_balance.notes: Balance before: 0.00498 ETH. After: 0.00396 ETH. Delta: -0.00102 ETH. Forecast gas ~0.0000078 ETH.

skillAssessment.overall: Well-structured SDK guide covering the full trading lifecycle. GraphQL queries, Polymarket price integration, and forecasting all work exactly as documented. However, the auction/trade flow has a critical gap: the skill (v0.4) describes EIP-712 types that don't match the published SDK (v0.2), and the server requires an undocumented 'escrowContract' field. An agent following the skill's trading instructions will fail at signature verification.
strengths: Comprehensive coverage: GraphQL queries, WS auctions, EIP-712 signing, on-chain minting, secondary market, forecasting, claiming
GraphQL queries work exactly as documented — copy-paste curl commands succeed
Polymarket price integration is well-documented and functional
SDK import reference table is helpful for discovering functions
Forecasting flow works perfectly via SDK submitForecast()
Good safety warnings about irreversible transactions and EIP-712 domain verification
Rate limits, error handling, and troubleshooting sections are useful
weaknesses: CRITICAL: Skill v0.4 describes EIP-712 AuctionIntent types that don't match published SDK v0.2 — agent cannot complete a trade
Server requires 'escrowContract' field in auction.start payload, not documented in skill
SDK import paths in skill (e.g., @sapience/sdk/contracts/addresses, @sapience/sdk/auction/escrowEncoding, @sapience/sdk/auction/escrowSigning) don't exist in published SDK v0.2
No working end-to-end trade example that an agent could copy — buildAuctionIntentTypedData, canonicalizePicks, computePickConfigId are referenced but not in SDK
Setup section assumes user has USDe and knows how to bridge to Ethereal — no direct acquisition path described
No testnet or paper-trading mode documented for safe testing
recommendations: Publish SDK v0.4 to npm to match skill's import paths and EIP-712 types
Add a complete end-to-end trade example (forecast + auction + mint) as a runnable script
Document the escrowContract field in auction.start payload
Add a 'verify setup' checklist: check WUSDe balance, check approval, check nonce availability
Consider adding a forecasting-only quick-start since it requires minimal setup

methodUsed: SDK (@sapience/sdk v0.2.0) + direct GraphQL API + WebSocket + viem wallet signing
keyFindings: GraphQL API (api.sapience.xyz/graphql) works perfectly, no auth required, 10+ active markets with real open interest
Forecasting via submitForecast() works end-to-end: EAS attestation on Arbitrum, ~$0.01 gas, confirmed on-chain
WebSocket (wss://relayer.sapience.xyz/auction) connects and processes messages, but EIP-712 signature verification fails due to protocol version mismatch
SDK v0.2 on npm uses SIWE auth + UMA/Pyth encodings; skill v0.4 describes EIP-712 AuctionIntent + picks-based protocol — incompatible
Server requires undocumented 'escrowContract' field in auction.start payload
Polymarket price integration via similarMarkets URLs works as documented
No WUSDe/USDe in test wallet — trading on Ethereal would require bridging funds
blockers: SDK version mismatch: published v0.2 doesn't implement v0.4 protocol described in skill (no buildAuctionIntentTypedData, canonicalizePicks, escrowSigning module)
EIP-712 AuctionIntent signature verification fails — cannot complete auction flow
No WUSDe on Ethereal — even if auction worked, mint would fail at collateral transfer
